messages:
devon: Heads-up — trying to finish onboarding for cleft-13b but hit a few blockers in runtime tests. Posting logs and notes for async triage.

maria: thanks — can you paste the weights/tokenizer locations?

devon: weights: s3://redwood-models/cleft-13b/v1/weights.tar.lz4
devon: tokenizer: s3://redwood-models/cleft-13b/v1/tokenizer.json + vocab.spm

lee: quick question — is this model using byte-level BPE or SentencePiece? that affects our decode path.

devon: SentencePiece trained with unk=0, pad=1, eos=2. Runtime currently expects pad_id=-1 for no-pad which leads to token id shifts in batch packing.

sam: ah yeah that will shift attention positions if pad gets folded into kv cache offsets. easier fix: set model_config.tokenizer_override = {"type":"sentencepiece","pad_id":1} in the serve config and redeploy.

nora: there's also a RoPE-related mismatch. Offline tests show perplexity spike after 1024 tokens. Runtime log shows: "WARNING: rope_scale mismatch: model metadata expects scale=1.8, runtime=1.0"

devon: exact error trace when running long-context smoke:
```
RuntimeError: mismatched rotary dims — expected 64, got 58 while applying RoPE scaling
  at runtime/attn/rotary.cpp:142
```

lee: interesting — model was trained with RoPE linear-scale factor 1.8 (metadata). We need to set serve-config: "rope_scaling: {type: 'linear', coef: 1.8}" or enable our legacy-compat path. Which option do you prefer?

devon: prefer explicit config so we don't auto-guess. I'll add a canary config.

sam: one more: model appears to have grouped Q/K projection (GQA) — if runtime uses MQA default you'll get head-dim shape mismatch. Error looked like: "matmul: shapes (B, H*qk, L) x (B, H, qk, K) incompatible"

nora: set model_config.attention = {"type":"gqa","group_size":2} for this model. Also check qk_head_dim in the loader (should be 64 here).

devon: patched serve-config locally:
```
model: cleft-13b-v1
weights_path: s3://redwood-models/cleft-13b/v1/weights.tar.lz4
tokenizer_override: { type: "sentencepiece", pad_id: 1, eos_id: 2 }
attention: { type: "gqa", group_size: 2, qk_head_dim: 64 }
rope_scaling: { type: "linear", coef: 1.8 }
```

ci-bot: build 3891 started for cleft-13b canary (devon) — running runtime-smoke-tests :gear:

maria: once canary passes, let's add an automated lint check that validates tokenizer pad/eos ids against runtime assumptions. Too many of these come from misaligned model cards.

lee: +1. Also add a check that GQA vs MQA is explicit in model metadata, not inferred.

oncall-bot: created ticket RED-4567 for follow-up (https://redwood.internal/issue/4567) — assign to eng-runtime. :spiral_note_pad:

devon: thanks all — will post canary results. if anyone wants to pair on the config PR ping me :eyes:
